blinding_guess.why: The reverse-socket framing between driver.py and prog is internally consistent for the paths the driver uses (servoj 1+6+1, set_payload 1, set_digital_out 2 integers). The controller-side consumption is version-pinned: the tcp/30003 parser accepts only packet lengths 756/812/1044 (else returns an empty object that __on_packet then dereferences), the tcp/30002 parser accepts only RobotModeData lengths 29/38, and the programmability check uses v1.x RobotMode constants (READY=2, RUNNING=0) even when the 3.0 layout is parsed. Whether the paired controller falls outside these versions cannot be told from the snapshot.

notes: ROS 1 (hydro); all QoS values null. The snapshot is the universal_robot repository; ur_driver is at snapshot/ur_driver. api:driverProg is a URScript program template (prog, installed to the package share dir by CMakeLists.txt:29-31) whose HOSTNAME/PORT are substituted at run time with the host IP and the reverse port (default 50001, driver.py:41, or the second command-line argument; ur_bringup/launch/ur_common.launch:15). The consumed api:* elements are URScript built-ins invoked from prog; they have no .msg/.srv definition, so msg_type and definition_id are null. Frame is null for driverProg, movej and servoj (joint-space targets, no coordinate frame stated) and for the two TCP resources (mixed state streams); units are not stated in prog or driver.py for any element. api:movej is called only in the MSG_MOVEJ (4) branch of prog (line 144; line 96 is a comment); driver.py defines MSG_MOVEJ but has no sender for it at this revision. servoj is called by prog's servoThread with (q, 0, 0, dt) where dt is received from the driver (4 * RATE = 0.08 s, driver.py:800); the driver sends MSG_SERVOJ from a rospy.Timer with period RATE = 0.02 s (driver.py:659, 678), which is a send period on the reverse socket, not a rate set for the servoj call itself, so rate_hz is left null. The rates in the comments at driver.py:39-40 (10 Hz on 30002, 125 Hz on 30003) describe the robot's streams and are not set by this code, so rate_hz is null for the resources. tcp/30002 is used both to upload the program (sendall) and to read RobotState packets (message type 16 required, deserialize.py:320-324); tcp/30003 is read-only (deserializeRT.py). exclusive is empty: no hardware command interface or exclusive device handle is claimed; the driver binds a listening TCPServer on the reverse port with allow_reuse_address=True (driver.py:544-546, 948), which the code does not name as an exclusive claim. prevent_programming (a ROS parameter) gates program upload but is not a permission declaration. prog also calls URScript functions outside the packet (socket_send_string, stopj, set_flag, set_analog_out, set_tool_voltage, sync, enter_critical/exit_critical). ROS interfaces outside the packet: topics joint_states, wrench, io_states; services ur_driver/setPayload, set_io; action follow_joint_trajectory. definition_hash.py was not needed because no packet element is a message, field, or definition.
